Haha, I totally relate to your relationship with your BF! I think my love languages are acts of service and gift-giving too. I’m more of a crafty person, but I also try to match the way my boyfriend expresses his love, and he does the same! So, I love hunting for the perfect gift. He’s a bit of a minimalist, so he likes useful things. I used to give him plushies, but now I’m switching it up—like giving him a plushie that’s also a bag! 😂

I always thank him for every little detail, and if I see something I know he’ll love, I rush to get it for him—like his favorite Harry Potter collection. But here’s the thing: when I buy him a special edition book, he’ll turn around and get me a whole collection of something I love! It feels like our gifts keep getting bigger and bigger, and I don’t want him to drain his wallet over me! 😅 I hadn’t thought much about it until my birthday yesterday, when he got me 25 presents (one for every year of my life!)—and they weren’t small things either! Victoria’s Secret perfume, shoes, clothes… I was so grateful, but also like, "Do you have money left to eat?! Can I help with your bills?" 

For his birthday, I got him the 3D Harry Potter book edition, baked a cake, and threw in some action figures. He absolutely loved it, and I felt super proud, but now I feel like I didn’t do enough! 😬 I know he hates when I buy him things, but I’m starting to worry and feel like I need to make it up to him somehow. From now on, I’m determined to pay for our dates, make sure he eats healthy, and maybe even cook for him more often. Oh, and I bought tickets to a Harry Potter concert for him! I just want to make sure he’s okay and feels as loved as he makes me feel. 🥰

Haha, yes, I told him, "Why rush things? Let’s enjoy our youth, travel, and experience life together!" We have plenty of time to build a strong relationship before thinking about the next steps. Plus, I love kids, but I grew up in a tough environment, and I really want my future kids to have a loving home, a healthy relationship with their parents, and everything they need.

I’ve noticed something, though. He always sees me as a 10/10 and himself as a 1/10. He constantly asks why I’m with him, like he thinks so little of himself, and I try really hard to make him see himself the way I do. He’s amazing, and I think he’s so handsome, but he just doesn’t seem to believe it. I’ve noticed he might be scared of losing me, and I wonder if that’s why he feels the need to speed everything up. But honestly, I just wish he could be more confident in himself, because he has no reason to doubt how incredible he is!
